title: Bullpen says unauthorized transfers hit early-beta accounts; Ansem says his Pump wallet was hacked
date_note: Both articles are dated 24 November and give no earlier day.
summary: Crypto trader Ansem said his Pump wallet was hacked and that his Bullpen profile appears to have been accessed. Decrypt reports Bullpen said it identified "unauthorized transfers involving Bullpen accounts opened during our early beta between April and June 2024", including Ansem's, and took the affected test service offline. Analysts such as MLM, quoted by Decrypt and Wikitree, say the on-chain activity does not look like a hack.
plain: Bullpen says it found unauthorized transfers involving accounts from its early beta, including Ansem's, per Decrypt. Ansem says his wallet was hacked; some analysts say the on-chain activity does not look like a hack.
exec: Bullpen has acknowledged unauthorized transfers on early-beta accounts, per Decrypt; analysts dispute that Ansem's sales were a hack and the cause is unsettled.
